mapper.select: SELECT tt.time_table_no, tt.yy, tt.mm, tt.dayname, tt.period_no, tt.start_time, tt.end_time, tt.time_table_code, tt.created_at, tt.updated_at, tt.user_no, cc.class_name FROM time_table tt JOIN class_code cc ON tt.class_no = cc.class_no WHERE tt.yy = #{yy} AND tt.mm = #{mm} AND tt.dayname = #{dayname} AND tt.end_time <= CAST(#{nowTimeHHmm} AS TIME)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_attendance (student_no, attendance_date, in_time, attendance_no, created_at) SELECT s.student_no, #{attendanceDate}, NULL, 3, -- 결석 코드 CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM time_table_assign ta JOIN student_tb s ON s.student_no = ta.student_no WHERE ta.time_table_code = #{timeTableCode} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_attendance sa WHERE sa.student_no = s.student_no AND sa.attendance_date = #{attendanceDate} )

INSERT INTO remedial (student_no, time_table_code, remedial_subject, absence_date, remedial_date, action, created_at, user_no) SELECT s.student_no, tt.time_table_code, cc.class_name, #{absenceDate}, '9999-12-31', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, tt.user_no FROM time_table_assign ta JOIN student_tb s ON s.student_no = ta.student_no JOIN time_table tt ON tt.time_table_code = ta.time_table_code JOIN class_code cc ON tt.class_no = cc.class_no WHERE tt.time_table_code = #{timeTableCode} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM student_attendance sa WHERE sa.student_no = s.student_no AND sa.attendance_date = #{absenceDate} AND sa.attendance_no = 3 -- 결석인 경우만 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM remedial r WHERE r.student_no = s.student_no AND r.time_table_no = tt.time_table_no AND r.absence_date = #{absenceDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sa SET sa.attendance_no = 2, sa.updated_at = SYSDATETIME() FROM student_attendance AS sa WHERE sa.attendance_date = #{attendanceDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND sa.in_time IS NOT NULL AND sa.in_time > ( SELECT t.start_time FROM time_table AS t WHERE t.time_table_code = #{timeTableCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND sa.student_no IN ( SELECT s.student_no FROM time_table_assign AS ta JOIN student_tb AS s ON s.student_no = ta.student_no WHERE ta.time_table_code = #{timeTableCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
